svg.title: 864-Joule AI Decision Anatomy and the 211x Economic Multiplier
svg.desc: Breakdown of the 864-Joule median AI decision (504 J accelerators, 216 J host CPU+DRAM, 144 J overhead), the 211x GPU time multiplier over electricity, and compounding hop x byte cuts up to 96.1%.
